overdue_fines_description: Automatically create fines for overdue borrowings that don't have fines yet.
overdue_need_processing_desc: This will create late return fines for all overdue borrowings that don't have fines yet.
no_overdue_processing_needed: No overdue borrowings need fine processing at this time.
automatic_detection_desc: System identifies overdue borrowings without fines.
fine_calculation_desc: Calculates late return fines based on days overdue and grace period.
member_notification_desc: Fines will appear in member dashboards and block further borrowing.
status_updates_desc: Borrowing status may change to "awaiting_fine_payment" if applicable.
